plan.failureSummary: The chatbot backend endpoint (/api/chat) returned HTTP 500 Internal Server Errors when processing user queries, preventing the chatbot from generating responses.
observedIndicators: Browser network logs show multiple HTTP 500 responses on 'https://briefcase.chat/api/chat'.
Browser console recorded 3 instances of 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 500 ()'.
Chat queries submitted by the AI runner rendered only empty response indicators without text due to backend API failure.
The autonomous agent correctly marked the objective not completable due to missing response generation from the backend.

remediationSteps.summary: Resolve the 500 Internal Server Error on the /api/chat backend endpoint.
remediationSteps.details: Inspect the backend service logs handling 'POST /api/chat' on briefcase.chat to diagnose and resolve the server-side exception causing HTTP 500 responses.

plan.notes: The autonomous flow aborted because the application's backend server failed (HTTP 500) whenever chat messages were sent, rendering the chatbot inoperable and unable to complete the topic compliance evaluation.
